ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Proceeds of Crime Act 1997 (Bermuda) as amended; Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing Code of Practice 2021; Companies Act 1981 (Bermuda); Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Amendment Act 2018; Bermuda Monetary Authority AML/ATF Guidance Notes.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of Residential Address (Utility Bill or Bank Statement, dated within 3 months)
Certificate of Good Standing (if existing corporate shareholder/director)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company Registry of Jurisdiction of Incorporation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against the Bermuda Sanctions List, HM Treasury Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, UN Consolidated List, EU Consolidated List, and Interpol notices. PEPs must undergo enhanced due diligence (EDD) under FATF Recommendation 12. BMA requires risk-based assessment, source of funds verification, and ongoing monitoring for all client relationships.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Bermuda Registrar of Companies – Companies and Land Registry online service (https://www.gov.bm/companies-registry)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All permitted names must be in English alphabet characters. Names in foreign scripts may be accepted only if presented in a precise romanized transliteration accompanied by a certified English translation. No non-English script may appear alone in the official corporate name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection of a name reservation, the applicant may file a written appeal to the Registrar of Companies within 14 days of the rejection notice, stating the grounds for seeking approval with supporting legal authorities and justification. The Registrar shall consider the appeal and issue a final administrative decision. If the Registrar continues to refuse, the applicant may apply to the Supreme Court of Bermuda for judicial review within 21 days of the Registrar's final decision.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure virtual office (Po Box or virtual address) is not acceptable for the statutory registered office. A physical street address in Bermuda is mandatory. Licensed corporate service providers, registered agents, and law firms may provide the registered office and physical substance support, but the company must maintain adequate business records and a local physical presence commensurate with its operations.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low_To_Moderate: For a non-regulated online retail and light-manufacturing business (epoxy resin dice casting), no mandatory physical inspection is required at incorporation. However, the Registrar of Companies or the BMA may, on reasonable suspicion or as part of random compliance audits, conduct an unannounced inspection to verify the existence of the registered office and books and records. The probability of such inspection is estimated at under 10% per annum given the low-risk profile.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Act 1981 of Bermuda (as amended), sections 4, 4A, 4B, 5, 8, 9, 14, 15 and 47; Business Licensing Act 2014; Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Companies, Ministry of Finance, Government of Bermuda, administered through licensed Bermuda corporate services providers
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum of Association (Form 1) together with the Declaration of Compliance submitted pursuant to section 8 of the Companies Act 1981 for issuance of a Certificate of Incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies under the Companies Act 1981; share capital may be denominated in any permitted currency and issued without paid-up funding; no escrow account or capital verification deposit is required for incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the subscribers to the Memorandum of Association subscribe for the initial issued shares of the Company, allotted as set out in the register of members, with consideration satisfied pursuant to the Board's capitalisation plan. RESOLVED that the registered office of the Company, at the office of its Bermuda resident representative as notified to the Registrar of Companies, is adopted as the Company's statutory office for service of process and record-keeping. RESOLVED that the following persons be and are hereby appointed as first officers to hold office until replaced by the Board: President, Secretary, and Chief Financial Officer, with delegated powers as the Board determines. RESOLVED that the filing of all incorporation documents and any incidental acts be and are hereby ratified and confirmed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Ministry of Finance, Government of Bermuda (online name clearance through the Registry portal or a licensed corporate service provider)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for reservation of the proposed exempted company name, which must end in Limited, Ltd., Incorporated, or a like statutory suffix. The Registrar will check the name against the existing register to confirm it is not misleading, offensive, or confusingly similar to an existing entity. Submit the application in English with a brief statement of the intended object clause referencing ISIC 3240 manufacture of tabletop gaming accessories.
required_dossiers: Exempted Company Name Reservation Application Form
Corporate object clause draft
Authorised person's identification document (passport copy) and proof of address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused on the ground of similarity, file a fresh application with a distinctive primary name or submit a letter of consent from the holder of the conflicting name; administrative re-submission is accepted within 30 days without a fresh fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation, Execution, and Submission of Incorporation Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Ministry of Finance, Government of Bermuda
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum of Association in the statutory Form 1, setting out the exempted company's name, registered office clause, share capital clause, and object clause, and append the Bye-laws. The incorporator (subscriber) must sign the Memorandum before a notary public in Bermuda or in the territory of incorporation, and sign the Declaration of Compliance acknowledging that all Companies Act 1981 requirements have been fulfilled. File the completed documents with the Registrar via a licensed corporate services provider or the electronic Registry platform.
required_dossiers: Memorandum of Association in Form 1 (duly executed and notarised)
Bye-laws of the exempted company
Declaration of Compliance with the Companies Act 1981
Consent of registered office provider
Consent of Bermuda resident representative
Certificate of incorporation application cover letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a query, correct the noted defects and re-file within 30 days; any obsolete or non-compliant clause is removed by way of a supplemental execution page; refusal of filing may be cured by resubmission after amendment, with an internal review request to the Registrar.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of Statutory Filing Fees and Stamp Duty
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Accountant General and Registrar of Companies, Ministry of Finance, Government of Bermuda
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Pay the incorporation fee of USD 1,755 by bank wire or by debit from the corporate services provider's approved account, quoting the assigned reference number. The fee includes the first calendar year's annual government fee; no share capital stamp duty is exigible where the subscriber shares are issued at par without premium.
required_dossiers: Payment remittance instruction with application reference
Bank receipt or settlement confirmation letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If payment is rejected or delayed, re-issue the wire with the correct beneficiary code and provide the updated SWIFT confirmation; an overpayment may be set off against future annual fees, and an underpayment is cured by a top-up remittance before certificate issuance.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Ministry of Finance, Government of Bermuda
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfaction that the incorporation documents are compliant and fees are paid, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation, which is conclusive evidence of the exempted company's existence and limited liability status. The certificate states the registration number, the date of incorporation, and the authorised capital; the company may thereafter hold property, contract, and commence lawful business, subject to licensing.
required_dossiers: Acknowledgment of incorporation filing
Copy of the Registry's payment receipt
Advance copy of the certificate for verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate is withheld, the applicant may obtain a written statement of deficiencies from the Registrar and file a corrective addendum; a formal internal appeal against refusal is available within 21 days of the adverse notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Recording of Registered Office and Bermuda Resident Representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Ministry of Finance, Government of Bermuda
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notice of the exempted company's registered office, which must be a physical address in Bermuda, and the appointment of the resident representative (individual or corporate service provider) who will accept service of process and maintain the statutory registers. Ensure the registered office address matches the consent already submitted and that the resident representative's agreement is in force.
required_dossiers: Notice of Registered Office (statutory form)
Notice of Resident Representative and consent
Registered office provider's acceptance letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the filing is rejected, appoint another Bermuda-registered office provider or resident representative and re-file the notice; any lapse is cured retroactively by the date of re-filing with the Registrar's acknowledgment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting and Post-Incorporation Governance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the Bermuda Exempted Company
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting (physically in Bermuda or by telephone/video conference subject to the Bye-laws) to adopt the pro-forma first board resolution covering share subscription, registered office adoption, and officer appointments. Issue the share certificate(s), open the corporate seal, approve the authorised signatories for bank accounts, and establish the register of members, register of directors and officers, and register of charges. Record the minutes and file any required returns with the Registrar.
required_dossiers: First board meeting notice and agenda
Pro-forma first board resolution (as set out in the incorporation_legal_framework)
Share certificates and allotment sheets
Register of members and register of directors and officers
Corporate seal and specimen signature card
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the board meeting cannot be convened promptly, the directors may pass a written resolution in lieu of a meeting under the Bye-laws and Companies Act 1981; ratification of the resolution is confirmed by circulation to all directors for signature.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Business Licensing Authority, Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economy and Labour, Government of Bermuda
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business Licence under the Business Licensing Act 2014 (active trading class: Manufacturing of Games and Toys, inclusive of handmade sharp-edge epoxy resin liquid core polyhedral dice casting)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR), Planning Division, Government of Bermuda
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B - Environmental Registration (Simplified Review); a full Environmental Impact Assessment Report is not mandatory for small-batch artisan casting operations with a resin throughput below 50 kg per month, but a registration statement and environmental management plan must be approved before commissioning the production line
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharged to municipal sewers must maintain pH 6.0 to 9.0, contain no free epoxy monomer, and have total suspended solids below 250 mg/L; airborne volatile organic compounds from resin hardening and curing shall not exceed 100 mg/m3 as carbon equivalent under the Clean Air Act 1991; cured and scrap epoxy shall be handled as industrial solid waste and removed by DENR-approved licensed carriers, while uncured resin and hardeners must be segregated as hazardous waste with a certified disposal manifest.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Inspection and Fire Certificate from the Bermuda Fire and Rescue Service covering the casting and curing rooms; structural load approval and building occupancy permit from the Department of Planning for the manufacturing premise; workplace clearance under the Occupational Safety and Health Act 1982 including chemical safety data sheet register, emergency eye-wash and ventilation inspection, electrical safety certification for dicing and polishing equipment, and verified safe handling procedures for sharp-edge and liquid-core products.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Bermuda: Office of the Tax Commissioner (OTC) — https://www.otcbermuda.gov.bm; Bermuda Registrar of Companies, Corporate Registry — https://www.roc.gov.bm; Bermuda Customs Department — https://www.gov.bm/customs. UK (supplementary VAT nexus): Her Majesty's Revenue and Customs (HMRC) — https://www.gov.uk/hmrc.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a foreign-owned Bermuda Exempted Company: (1) incorporate under the Companies Act 1981 through a licensed Bermuda resident agent — no minimum capital requirement; (2) obtain the Certificate of Incorporation with the Company Registration Number (CRN) from the Registrar of Companies; the CRN serves as the Bermuda statutory tax identifier because no separate income-tax TIN is issued; (3) register with OTC for Payroll Tax and with the Social Insurance Board only if employing staff — no VAT or corporate TIN is procured in Bermuda; (4) obtain a Customs importer/exporter licence from Bermuda Customs via ASYCUDA World electronic registration; (5) if a UK VAT registration point arises (first taxable supply of goods in or to the UK, including through a UK warehouse or agent), file Form VAT1 with HMRC as a Non-Established Taxable Person (NETP) — registration is mandatory before the first supply and a UK tax representative may be required.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone — the Bermuda Exempted Company is exempt from Bermuda corporate income tax, capital gains, withholding tax, and indirect tax; subject to the 15% Bermuda Corporate Income Tax (CIT) only if the group's consolidated annual revenue equals or exceeds EUR 750 million (Corporate Income Tax Act 2023); the present low-revenue tabletop gaming dice-casting business falls outside the CIT charge.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box mechanism exists in Bermuda. Available elections: (a) Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Certificate under the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966, granting a statutory tax-exemption guarantee until 31 March 2035; (b) in-scope MNE groups may elect CIT exclusion or equivalence treatment under the CIT Act 2023 transitional rules; (c) voluntary or mandatory UK VAT registration (NETP) to recover input VAT and zero-rate qualifying exports; (d) UK hybrid mismatch rules (CTA 2010 Part 6A) are inapplicable because the exempted company is a non-UK tax resident entity outside UK corporation tax.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Bermuda: no VAT/GST/sales-and-use tax; imports bear customs duty under the Customs Tariff Act 1947; exports are duty-free. UK VAT (20% headline rate) applies on an extra-territorial nexus basis where the Bermuda Exempted Company makes taxable supplies in the UK.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Bermuda: nil — no VAT registration threshold exists because no VAT regime is in force; Customs registration is turnover-independent. UK (ancillary): nil threshold for a non-established taxable person — HMRC registration is due from the first taxable supply in the UK; the £90,000 annual threshold applies only to UK-established suppliers.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Bermuda: no e-invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API, or digital stamping mandate; all customs transactions (import/export declarations) are lodged electronically through ASYCUDA World. UK: Making Tax Digital for VAT mandates API-based digital record-keeping and VAT return filing; HMRC has announced mandatory e-invoicing for VAT-registered businesses on a phased basis from 2027 onwards; no real-time fiscal clearance stamping is presently in force.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Bermuda: export sales are outside any Bermudian tax charge, rendering zero-rating unnecessary. For UK VAT obligations (NETP or UK-established status): goods physically exported from the UK to a non-UK destination within three months of the time of supply qualify for zero-rating under VATA 1994, Sch 8, Grp 13, subject to strict evidential proof (export declaration, transport documents, destination evidence); ancillary services performed directly in connection with exported goods may also be zero-rated.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bermuda Customs Export Entry (ASYCUDA World electronic declaration)
UK Customs Export Declaration (CDS / SAD C21) where the goods depart from the UK
Bill of Lading or Master/House Air Waybill evidencing dispatch to a non-UK destination
Proof of export (customs stamped copy, carrier certificate, port/airport departure seal)
Inward Remittance Certificate / SWIFT credit advice evidencing FX repatriation
Underlying sales contracts, Kickstarter campaign records, Stripe/PayPal transaction logs
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Bermuda: false customs/export declarations are penalised under the Customs Act 1948 (monetary penalties, forfeiture, imprisonment) and can lead to revocation of Exempted Undertaking tax protection under the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966. UK: misclaimed export zero-rating is clawed back by HMRC assessment for 4 years (ordinary care), 6 years (careless), or 20 years (deliberate evasion), with up to 100% civil penalties under Schedule 24 Finance Act 2007, default interest, and criminal liability for fraudulent evasion of VAT under VATA 1994 s.72 (up to 7 years' imprisonment); officers of the Exempted Company may be personally liable for consenting or conniving in the offence.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Bermuda Monetary Authority (BMA) — the integrated regulatory, supervisory, and central monetary authority for Bermuda
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Bermuda maintains an open monetary regime with no systemic exchange controls. The Bermudian dollar (BMD) is pegged at parity to the US dollar (USD). Both current account and capital account transactions are freely convertible. Profit remittances, dividends, and distributions may be repatriated to non-resident shareholders without exchange control authorization or Bermuda withholding tax, subject only to standard AML/CFT vetting and bank formality.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender or repatriation requirement applies in Bermuda. Export receipts from the sale of handmade sharp-edge epoxy resin liquid core RPG dice may be held in USD, BMD, or any freely convertible currency at commercial bank discretion. The BMA imposes no mandatory conversion ratio, no confirmation timeline, and no surrender obligation on export proceeds.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of N.T. Butterfield & Son Limited

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium-High as an ancillary collection and supplier payment rail, but Low as the primary treasury relationship. A non-Bermuda electronic money institution (EMI) may not lawfully accept deposits or provide regulated payment services to Bermuda entities without appropriate licensing or an approved waiver. A properly licensed EMI in the United Kingdom or European Economic Area can be used for low-value digital marketplace collections, while capital injection and trade settlements must remain on BMA-supervised domestic banking rails to preserve audit trail integrity.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance is generally preferred for at least one director or beneficial owner, but remote opening is permitted if the applicant holds a low-risk profile and can complete video identity verification plus notarized corporate documents. A structured video interview with the compliance officer is normally mandatory. For the Bermuda Exempted Company in the handmade gaming accessories trade, remote onboarding is viable provided the board pack includes certified constitutional documents, a registered office confirmation, and independent source-of-wealth evidence for all shareholders.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore jurisdiction perception of the Bermuda Exempted Company and fully non-resident ownership
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide BMA-exempted status confirmation, certificate of incorporation, valid registered agent and registered office certificate, tax residence statement, complete register of directors and members, and a detailed group structure chart identifying economic substance rationale.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Pass-through personality or lack of physical commercial activity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit the Kickstarter/Stripe merchant agreement, PayPal business account contract, supplier invoices for epoxy resin, polyhedral moulds and pigments, warehouse or fulfilment centre evidence, and an operating model memo explaining the underwriting, casting, curing, inspection, and shipping workflow.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid cross-border payment velocity or unexplained crowdfunding inflows
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Maintain customer order logs, shipment tracking numbers, customs declarations, refund policies, prototype photography, campaign model descriptions, and a contemporaneous accounting ledger city that links every inbound campaign contribution to a matching physical product delivery.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusual FX forward requirement for a BMD/USD pegged jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a risk management policy memo showing that GBP/EUR denominated procurement from European mould suppliers or resin suppliers creates genuine foreign currency exposure requiring forward hedging, supported by supplier contracts and purchase orders.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocols are: (i) shareholder equity injection via SWIFT MT103 with remittance field referencing 'Share Capital Contribution to Bermuda Exempted Company'; (ii) formal board resolution recording the issue of shares and consideration received; (iii) passing of source-of-funds verification using bank statements, tax confirmation, and beneficial ownership declarations; and (iv) BMA-exempted company statutory forms updated to record the capital movement. Bermuda imposes no exchange control filing for inward funds, yet the bank requires a completed corporate wiring form, proof of underlying transaction, and final economic substance declaration before crediting the Operational Account.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade disbursements are effected through SWIFT MT103 for direct supplier remittances, MT202 for bank-to-bank positioning, and commercial letters of credit where the counterparty requires transactional security. Small-value supplier payments may also clear through the automated clearing house, wire, and renowned third-party payment platforms. All outbound settlement references should include invoice numbers, purchase order references, and the ISIC 3240 trade description to support bank due diligence and downstream logistics reconciliation.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/BMD natural peg eliminates domestic hedging requirement
GBP/USD deliverable forward contracts for European resin and mould suppliers
EUR/USD deliverable forward contracts for EU-based finishing chemicals and packaging
GBP/EUR cross-currency forward contracts for diversified procurement
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) only where a BMD deliverable hedge is cost-inefficient or the counterparty cannot settle in BMD
Currency swaps for medium-term supplier finance or intercompany working capital alignment

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (eReturn) and Annual Company Fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Government of Bermuda (Corporate Registry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 15 January each year for the preceding calendar year; the first return is due in the calendar year immediately following incorporation even when no transactions occurred.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A late-payment surcharge of 10% of the annual fee accrues immediately after 15 January. If the eReturn and fee remain outstanding for approximately six months, the Registrar of Companies may publish a strike-off notice and administratively dissolve the company. Restoration requires a court or Registrar application, payment of all outstanding fees and penalties, and additional legal costs.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Economic Substance Declaration (ES Form) under the Economic Substance Act 2018
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies (Economic Substance Unit), Government of Bermuda
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after each financial year-end (calendar-year exempted companies: by 30 June); a declaration remains mandatory even where the entity is a pure equity-holding company or undertakes no relevant activity.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file, or knowingly filing false information, is a criminal offence carrying corporate fines up to BMD 250,000 plus continuing daily default penalties. The Registrar may also mark the company non-compliant, which blocks certificates of good standing, suspends administrative services, and can, on aggravated or prolonged default, support administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership (UBO) Register Update and Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Government of Bermuda (Beneficial Ownership Platform, operated in coordination with the Bermuda Financial Intelligence Agency)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation is bundled with the 15 January eReturn cycle; any shareholding transfer or change in ultimate beneficial ownership must be updated within 30 days of the change.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Under the Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Amendment Act 2017, non-maintenance or inaccurate filing of beneficial ownership particulars exposes the company and every implicated officer to statutory monetary penalties and, knowingly, imprisonment. Persistent non-compliance leads to designation as a non-compliant entity, suspension of certificates of good standing, and ultimate administrative strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No universal statutory audit applies to a Bermuda exempted company. An independent audit becomes compulsory only where: (i) equity or debt is listed on a recognized stock exchange; (ii) the company holds a licence or permit regulated by the Bermuda Monetary Authority (banking, insurance, investment business, trust); (iii) it holds a permit company status with conditions requiring audited accounts; or (iv) constitutional documents, shareholders' agreements, or funding-receiving platform agreements expressly require audited financial statements. This tabletop gaming accessories company does not trigger any Bermuda size, turnover, or asset-based audit threshold.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by the IASB. Bermuda exempted companies are not required to file financial statements with the Registrar; when financial statements are voluntarily or contractually required, they are prepared under IFRS.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The exempted company must maintain a beneficial ownership register and file current UBO particulars with the Registrar's Beneficial Ownership Platform. The annual confirmation is executed through the 15 January eReturn cycle; each transfer of shares or change in ultimate ownership must be recorded within 30 days, with the licensed corporate service provider conducting identity verification under Bermuda AML/ATF rules at incorporation, on transfer, and on any material change. For a single-class founding-shareholder structure without transfers during the year, a simplified annual confirmation statement suffices.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$1,500 - US$3,000 per annum for a licensed Bermuda corporate services provider covering the registered office, corporate secretary, eReturn preparation, UBO platform updates, and register maintenance.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$8,000 - US$18,000 per annum for a voluntary IFRS audit of a small exempted company; otherwise not required for a non-listed, non-licensed entity.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 15% (Corporate Income Tax Act 2023; applies only to constituent entities of in-scope multinational groups with consolidated annual revenue of at least EUR 750 million for two of the prior four years; out-of-scope Bermuda Exempted Companies pay 0% corporate income tax)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0% effective CIT for out-of-scope exempted companies; Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966 certificate protects the company until 31 March 2035 against any future Bermuda income tax, capital gains tax, or capital transfer tax; no accelerated deductions or patent box; employer payroll tax remains chargeable on Bermuda employee emoluments at progressive rates up to 10.25%
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Indefinite (CIT Act 2023 permits indefinite carryforward of qualifying losses for in-scope MNE groups, subject to an 80% annual taxable income offset cap; no loss regime applicable to out-of-scope entities as no CIT is levied)

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Quarterly Employer's Payroll Tax Return (Statutory Form under the Payroll Tax Act 1995), filed electronically through the Office of the Tax Commissioner portal (taxcomm.bm)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Quarterly (employers with annual payroll tax liability below the threshold may be approved for quarterly filing; monthly filing may be mandated for larger employers)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Return and full payment due on or before the 15th day of the month following each calendar quarter; final annual reconciliation and payment due on 31 January after the tax year end

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross emoluments paid to all employees during the period, including salaries, wages, bonuses, commissions, benefits-in-kind and deemed emoluments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include all remuneration for services performed in Bermuda; emoluments paid to non-resident employees for duties carried out entirely outside Bermuda are excluded; directors' fees are taxable only to the extent attributable to duties performed in Bermuda

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exempt emoluments claimed under the Payroll Tax Act 1995 Schedules (e.g., statutory pension contributions, certain health insurance premiums, redundancy payments up to prescribed caps)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident employees are not entitled to Bermuda-specific exemptions unless they are statutory residents or the employer supports the claim with payroll records and contemporaneous time sheets
Compute by subtracting allowed exemptions only; amounts paid into an overseas pension scheme are not exempt unless the scheme is recognized by the Tax Commissioner

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Payroll tax payable applying the progressive band rates
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No special rate for non-residents; failure to deduct from offshore payroll may trigger employer penalty assessments

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Late payment surcharge and accrued interest
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter only if the Tax Commissioner has issued an assessment for interest at the prescribed rate (currently 2% per month on unpaid tax)

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing and payment: automatic penalty of 10% of unpaid tax plus monthly interest at 2% per month; continued default may lead to court-ordered recovery, deregistration of the employer, and criminal prosecution for false returns with fines and imprisonment of up to 5 years

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Corporate Income Tax Return under the Corporate Income Tax (Compliance and Administration) Act 2023, filed via the Bermuda Tax Commissioner's online CIT portal once operational for in-scope MNE groups
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing and payment due within 15 months after the end of the entity's fiscal year (or on the extended date granted by the Tax Commissioner for the MNE group's GloBE information return)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal entity name, exempted company registration number, tax residence jurisdiction, fiscal year start and end dates, and MNE group identifier assigned by the Tax Commissioner
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A Bermuda exempted company that is managed and controlled outside Bermuda must nevertheless file if it is a constituent entity of an in-scope MNE group; disclose the ultimate parent entity located in the UK or elsewhere

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part I - GloBE Income or Loss
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Determination of financial accounting net income or loss before GloBE adjustments, with mandatory adjustments for taxes, dividends, equity gains, and excluded items under the OECD Pillar Two Model Rules
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the group's common consolidated accounting standard for the ultimate parent; foreign-held entities must reconcile local statutory accounts to the group accounting standard

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Eligible payroll and tangible asset carve-out calculation based on Bermudian employees and tangible assets used in Bermuda
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident remote employees and foreign-held equipment do not qualify for the exclusion; documentary evidence of physical presence in Bermuda must be retained

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part III - Covered Taxes and Effective Tax Rate
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Calculation of adjusted covered taxes (including foreign taxes) attributable to the entity and the resulting effective tax rate for the jurisdiction
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Bermuda payroll taxes and social insurance are not covered taxes; UK corporation tax paid on UK-source income may be allocated to the UK under the assignment rules

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of the jurisdictional top-up tax under the 15% minimum rate, including the IIR and qualified domestic minimum top-up tax (QDMTT) safe harbour
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A Bermudian entity wholly owned by a UK parent must still compute and disallow the IIR safe harbour if the UK parent has not implemented an equivalent IIR

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Fixed penalty of BMD 10,000 for failure to file, plus BMD 1,000 per month for each month of continued non-compliance; understatement penalties of up to 50% of the tax shortfall; deliberate concealment is prosecuted as an offence with fines up to BMD 250,000 and imprisonment; unpaid CIT bears interest at the statutory prescribed rate until settlement

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Economic Substance Annual Declaration (ESD) filed electronically through the Registrar of Companies portal (esd.gov.bm)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing due within 6 months after the company's financial year end

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exempted company name, registered number, financial year end, immediate parent, ultimate parent, and jurisdiction of tax residence
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A foreign-managed company must disclose that its place of effective management is outside Bermuda; such an assertion triggers enhanced review by the Registrar

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selection of the relevant activity, if any, from the prescribed statutory list (banking, insurance, fund management, finance and leasing, headquarters, shipping, distribution and service centre, or IP business); otherwise declare 'none' or 'pure equity holding entity'
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Handmade tabletop dice manufacturing is not a designated relevant activity; if the company also holds IP licences or acts as a regional headquarters for the UK group, the corresponding activity must be disclosed

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: For entities with relevant activities, certify that core income-generating activities, employees, premises, and expenditure are present in Bermuda in proportion to the income derived
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Remote UK-based founder operations cannot satisfy the test; the entity must evidence local employment contracts, physical office space, and local board meetings for any relevant activity

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of employees employed in Bermuda, their work permits or Bermudian status, and total payroll expenditure
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors or employees not working in Bermuda must not be counted; misdeclaration is treated as an offence under the Economic Substance Amendment Act 2023

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file on time attracts a fixed penalty of BMD 10,000 plus BMD 5,000 per day of continued default; false declarations are punishable by fines up to BMD 250,000 and imprisonment; the Registrar may strike off the exempted company and report non-compliance to the Bermuda Tax Commissioner

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Bermuda imposes no withholding tax on dividends paid by an exempted company, under the absence of any income tax or dividend withholding legislation
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable - Bermuda has no comprehensive double tax treaties and no mechanism for treaty relief on outbound dividends; the Tax Commissioner may issue a Certificate of Residence for foreign tax credit purposes, but no domestic tax is withheld to be relieved; a UK parent company receiving a Bermuda dividend will normally receive an exempt dividend without any tax credit in the UK
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory withholding on both royalties and interest; no domestic tax is imposed on outbound IP royalty payments or debt interest paid by a Bermuda exempted company to foreign lenders or licensors; the UK recipient would be taxable in the UK on such Bermuda-source income only under UK domestic rules

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable - Bermuda has no standalone transfer pricing documentation regime under the Payroll Tax Act or Companies Act; in-scope MNE groups subject to the Corporate Income Tax Act 2023 must apply the OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines to determine arm's length pricing for transactions between constituent entities and must maintain contemporaneous documentation only where required by the ultimate parent jurisdiction (e.g., UK Master File and Local File under UK TTPA 2010 if the UK parent exceeds the GBP 50 million turnover or GBP 5 million related-party transaction thresholds)
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Economic Substance Regulations 2018 (as amended) apply to Bermuda exempted companies conducting designated relevant activities such as banking, insurance, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, shipping, distribution and service centres, or IP business; tabletop dice casting is not a designated relevant activity, so no sectoral substance test applies; however, every exempted company, including a pure equity holding entity, must annually file the Economic Substance Declaration and maintain a reasonable degree of local presence (registered office, local corporate records, and compliance arrangements); an entity that merely holds IP or routing sales from a UK parent without local substance will be classified as an IP business or distribution and service centre respectively and will be required to pass the full economic substance test or face penalties and potential strike-off

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately understating gross emoluments, paying employees in cash without registration as an employer, filing false quarterly payroll returns, or deliberately misclassifying executives as independent contractors to avoid Bermuda payroll tax
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Summary conviction: fine not exceeding BMD 100,000 plus an additional penalty of up to three times the tax evaded, and imprisonment for a term not exceeding 5 years; the Tax Commissioner may also issue assessments for the full unpaid payroll tax with 10% late charge and 2% monthly compounding interest
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Bermuda law allows the Tax Commissioner to collect as a civil debt against directors who knowingly signed or directed false returns; individual directors face personal restitution orders, travel bans pending tax prosecution, disqualification from acting as directors for up to 10 years, and imprisonment for fraud

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company - Failure to Maintain Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Bermuda exempted company as a pure conduit that registers as a non-resident shell, holds no local employees or office, is managed from the UK, and fails to file the Economic Substance Declaration or deliberately classifies itself as a pure equity holding company while actually carrying on a distribution or IP business
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fixed penalty of BMD 10,000 for late ESD filing plus BMD 5,000 per day of continued default; the Registrar may strike off the company and the Tax Commissioner may impose additional penalties of up to BMD 250,000 for false declarations; the company loses the benefit of the tax protection certificate and becomes liable to any future Bermuda tax legislation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who signed a false ESD are personally liable for the penalty amounts; the court may order civil restitution of any tax benefit obtained, issue travel bans where the director is about to leave Bermuda, impose director disqualification orders, and in severe cases impose imprisonment for perjury in statutory declarations

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the tabletop dice business through Stripe and PayPal without maintaining an effective AML/ATF compliance programme, failing to identify beneficial owners, processing payments for anonymous third parties, or using the exempted company as a shell to launder funds disguised as crowdfunding proceeds
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing Act 2018 and the Proceeds of Crime Act 1997, the company is liable to fines of up to BMD 250,000 per contravention; senior staff face fines of BMD 100,000; in a criminal money laundering prosecution, confiscation orders may seize all assets connected to the offence and imprisonment may extend to 10 years
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and AML compliance officers owe a personal statutory duty under the AML/ATF regime; breach can result in personal criminal conviction, civil recovery and restitution of laundered amounts, freezing of personal assets, court-imposed travel bans, and imprisonment; the corporate veil is pierced where the director knowingly profited from the offence

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: UK Tax Avoidance - CFC and Offshore Diversion
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Structuring the sale of handmade dice through the Bermuda exempted company to divert profits from UK-resident economic activity (marketing, design, customer service) without real substance in Bermuda, thereby triggering the UK Controlled Foreign Company regime or the UK transfer pricing rules in HMRC's favour
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: UK corporation tax is charged at the 19%-25% rate on the diverted profits of the CFC; HMRC may impose transfer pricing adjustments with penalties up to 100% of underpaid tax, interest on overdue tax, and court costs; advance payment notices can require payment of the disputed tax before appeal proceedings conclude
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: UK-resident directors who are involved in the offshore arrangement can be liable for penalties for facilitating the tax evasion under the Criminal Finances Act 2017, including unlimited fines and up to 10 years imprisonment; in parallel, HMRC may apply for director disqualification under the Company Directors Disqualification Act 1986 and travel restrictions, while Bermuda courts may separately enforce personal civil liability where the director caused the loss to the company
